findings.title: Test imports "./index.ts", which the tsconfig rejects
findings.why: tsconfig.json includes src (so the test file) and sets no allowImportingTsExtensions or noEmit. Under NodeNext, tsc reports TS5097 for a ".ts" import path, so the type check or a build fails. package.json also lists no TypeScript dependency, and `node --test` needs a Node version that strips types.

findings.title: commonSuffixLengths name and comment do not match what it computes
findings.why: The table holds LCS lengths of from[i..] and to[j..], taking a max when items differ. It is not a table of common-suffix lengths.

findings.title: Local function `fetch` shadows the global `fetch`
findings.why: A name such as `resolveValue` would avoid confusion with the global.

findings.title: Confusing test comment about "ancestor-free prefix of nothing"
findings.why: The comment does not describe what the assertion checks. The test moves /a/b to /a, where from is longer than path, so the prefix rule does not apply.

findings.title: Plan documents are empty scaffolds, and task bodies keep the scaffold comment
findings.why: Plans 1-2 to 1-5 contain only the placeholder comment, with no plan body. Tasks 002 to 005 also keep the scaffold comment that says to replace it.
